entities.summary: Huashan Hospital, formerly Chinese Red Cross General Hospital, is founded by Red Cross Society of China in 1907. It is the district general hospital operated by the Red Cross Society of China in Shanghai, China, and is affiliated with the Shanghai Medical College of Fudan University.
